column1: # One row per public field of the client, server and publisher copies, in digest order.

# owner: client | server | publisher. digest: how StateDigest folds it (raw bits, bool byte, int, long, unsigned byte, enum id, enum ordinal, tail = the retained movement list, again = a second fold of an inherited field, none). The publisher's rows reach only the boundary digest.
# future: read = the next step reads it, so it names the future; unread = the next step overwrites it first; partial = compared through a derived value the comparison names.
# schema: the first boundary schema that carries the field.
